About the First Saturday Ocean Springs Community Ride (Tato-Nut) group ride

A relaxed family ride through shaded neighborhoods, along the beachfront road and through Gulf Islands National Seashore. Any bike, any age. It follows the Live Oaks Bicycle Trail and is known locally as the Tato-Nut ride, after the donut shop. Confirm the start time with TriHard Sports.
